messages:
sam: thanks for the follow92up after the Q&A. leadership asked for a single thread capturing why we92re winning/losing + top asks customers keep raising. drop 192line owners/status pls.

maya: Sales summary: wins = fast pilot ROI, clear perf numbers, and handson SE support. losses = procurement wants deterministic cost caps, slower legal reviews for data residency, and lack of certified HSM/KMS options for some finance customers.

liam: CS signal: repeated asks for longer audit log retention and searchable request traces for compliance. also customers want an \"on-call\" SLA during pilots for quick incident response.

sophia: Product: top asks consolidated = (1) private/VPC + onprem roadmap with certification milestones, (2) purchasable SLO/coverage blocks, (3) token-level CSV exports + per-route cost caps, and (4) partner enablement kit (runbook + demo prompts).

devin: Eng: runtime improvements (KV caching + quantization tuning) landing next month. also prototyping adaptive-fallback chains so heavy requests drop to a quantized variant instead of timing out. PRs under `runtime/fallback` and `runtime/quant-tune`.

olga: Research/Optimize: customers push for automated quantization recommendations per workload and better A/B tools for quality/cost tradeoffs. hallucination mitigation + reranking requested for legal/healthcare verticals.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-5188 \"AH: wins & roadmap asks\" assigned: maya, devin, sophia.

sam: owners please add a 1line customer-facing blurb and ETA to the ticket by Mon COB. we need a 1pager for partners.

maya: will own pricing + procurement playbook for midmarket. ETA Tue.

devin: will own fallback + perf SLO draft and include bench links. ETA Wed.
sophia: will author the partner enablement kit skeleton and list required certs for Private. ETA EOW.

liam: CS will scrub 3 loss postmortems and provide sanitized prompts + customer quotes for marketing.

devin: small ask  can we expose a beta `console.feature.token_export` flag for per-request CSVs? if Product approves we can beta with 3 customers.
sophia: approve conceptually will scope and add to the Product brief.

docs-bot: doc created: /internal/all-hands/1801001234-cust-signal-roundup (restricted).

ci-bot: reminder: include a short risk note if we commit to 1y log retention (storage/cost impact).

sam: perfect. one last ask please note any blocker (legal, infra, or finance) directly on the ticket so leadership can unblock. closing thread; will post the 1pager once tickets are updated. :thumbsup:
